why: Per the curated ontology: a kubelet-recorded OOMKilled on a pod (its container lastState, or an OOMKilled event) is a MEASURED co-occurrence with the cgroup out-of-memory phenomenon on the same workload role. It corroborates that phenomenon — it does not prove it, and it asserts nothing about why the memory was exhausted. The fact is recorded even when the cgroup OOM counter is unavailable, so it is the more reliable signal of the two; the two are surfaced adjacently, each labelled MEASURED.
author: vigil-engineering
